<description>
`/rest/spenttxouts/<hash>` reads the undo file for every block above genesis. For a block that was stored but never connected (a side branch) or whose undo data was pruned, there is no undo position, so `OpenUndoFile()` fails and `ReadBlockUndo()` writes `OpenUndoFile failed for FlatFilePos(nFile=-1, nPos=0)` to debug.log with `LogError`. The request itself already returns 404, but each unauthenticated request for such a block adds an `[error]` line that looks like disk corruption.

This checks `CheckBlockDataAvailability()` for `BLOCK_HAVE_UNDO` before reading, so nothing is logged. Pruning clears `BLOCK_HAVE_UNDO`, so pruned blocks are covered too. The response is unchanged.

The new check at the end of `interface_rest.py` requests a stale block and fails on master because of the logged error.
</description>

<commits>
e8af2c7488 rest: don't log an error for /spenttxouts on a block without undo data

`/rest/spenttxouts/<hash>` calls `ReadBlockUndo()` for every block above
genesis. For a block that was stored but never connected (a side branch)
or whose undo data was pruned, `GetUndoPos()` is null, so
`OpenUndoFile()` fails and `ReadBlockUndo()` writes "OpenUndoFile failed
for FlatFilePos(nFile=-1, nPos=0)" to debug.log with `LogError`. The
endpoint then correctly answers 404, but every unauthenticated request
for such a block adds an `[error]` line that looks like disk corruption.

Check `CheckBlockDataAvailability()` for `BLOCK_HAVE_UNDO` first and
only read the undo file when it can exist. Pruning clears
`BLOCK_HAVE_UNDO`, so this covers pruned blocks too. The response is
unchanged.

The new interface_rest.py check requests a side-branch block and fails
on master because of the logged error.
</commits>

index bfdde38c56..a17484fa15 100644
--- a/src/rest.cpp
+++ b/src/rest.cpp
@@ -372,8 +372,12 @@ static bool rest_spent_txouts(const std::any& context, HTTPRequest* req, const s
     }
 
     CBlockUndo block_undo;
-    if (pblockindex->nHeight > 0 && !chainman->m_blockman.ReadBlockUndo(block_undo, *pblockindex)) {
-        return RESTERR(req, HTTP_NOT_FOUND, hashStr + " undo not available");
+    if (pblockindex->nHeight > 0) {
+        // Blocks that were never connected or have been pruned have no undo data.
+        const bool have_undo{WITH_LOCK(cs_main, return chainman->m_blockman.CheckBlockDataAvailability(*pblockindex, *pblockindex, BlockStatus{BLOCK_HAVE_UNDO}))};
+        if (!have_undo || !chainman->m_blockman.ReadBlockUndo(block_undo, *pblockindex)) {
+            return RESTERR(req, HTTP_NOT_FOUND, hashStr + " undo not available");
+        }
     }
